name: Muriel Johnstone
story: Muriel Johnstone contributed Ōraka Aparima place-name knowledge to Kā Huru Manu, drawing on her grandparents’ teaching and consulting whānau before sharing family material.
Kā Huru Manu’s early paepae included Trevor Howse, Kelly Davis, Matapura Ellison, Jimmy Russell and David Higgins, while Muriel Johnstone contributed knowledge of the Ōraka Aparima takiwā.
